title: GUI Component Consolidation
outcome_summary: Delivered a full GUI component consolidation for the MCP Server Dashboard: introduced a `components.js` UI namespace with 5 render functions (badge, banner, emptyState, card, filterBar), migrated all inline badge/banner/card/filter-bar patterns across 10 view files, and replaced ~120 CSS dark-mode override lines with 66 semantic custom-property tokens across 23 badge and 4 banner variants. All 8 work packages completed cleanly with 3,095 tests passing and 0 failures in the final state. One QA rework occurred (WP-003) due to missing components.js setup in test files — a vitest setup file is the top recommended follow-up to prevent this class of regression.
